title: Governed Sovereign RAG for Public Administration: Tripartite Epistemic Routing, Facet-Guided Clarification, and Deterministic Numeric Verification in Citizen Services
abstract: arXiv:2610.36561v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deploying conversational assistants at government service desks faces a tension between regulatory certainty (zero tolerance for invented fees), data sovereignty prohibiting commercial clouds, and high rates of underspecified or out-of-jurisdiction citizen queries. We present and evaluate a governed, sovereign Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture deployed on the official portal of the State of Tlaxcala, Mexico (tlaxcaladigital.gob.mx), covering 1,143 procedures and a decoupled directory of 924 offices. translated_title: 面向公共行政的受管控主权RAG：公民服务中的三方认知路由、分面引导澄清与确定性数值验证
translated_abstract: 在政府服务窗口部署对话式助手面临多重张力：监管确定性（对捏造费用的零容忍）、禁止使用商业云的数据主权要求，以及大量欠明确或超出管辖范围的公民查询。我们提出并评估了一种受管控的主权检索增强生成（RAG）架构，部署于墨西哥特拉斯卡拉州官方门户网站（tlaxcaladigital.gob.mx），覆盖1,143项办事流程以及解耦的924个办事机构目录。该系统通过三大支柱治理交互：（1）两阶段三方认知门控（clarify_policy 和基于 AnyJev 的玻尔兹曼分布），在直接回答（SPECIFIC）、分面引导澄清（CLARIFY）与拒答（ABSTAIN）之间进行仲裁；（2）生成后的确定性数值验证器（verify_numeric_guardrail），结合 SHA-256 缓存失效机制，确保每个生成的费用或有效期数字均归属……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出并评估了一种部署于墨西哥特拉斯卡拉州官方门户的受管控主权RAG架构，通过三方认知路由门控、分面引导澄清和带SHA-256缓存失效的确定性数值验证三大支柱，解决政府公民服务中监管确定性、数据主权与查询模糊性之间的矛盾。
en_tdlr: This paper presents and evaluates a governed sovereign RAG architecture deployed on the official portal of the State of Tlaxcala, Mexico, which reconciles regulatory certainty, data sovereignty, and ambiguous citizen queries through three pillars: a tripartite epistemic routing gate, facet-guided clarification, and deterministic numeric verification with SHA-256 cache invalidation.
